# Pinned notices for browser shims embedded by docx 9.7.1

`docx/dist/index.mjs` is a prebuilt package artifact. Its esbuild-preserved
comments identify the three browser shims below, but the npm package does not
publish their package metadata. These records pin the attribution and complete
license terms that accompany the shipped code. All ordinary docx dependencies
and their transitive dependencies are inventoried separately from the locked
install by `scripts/build-vendor.mjs`.
